definitions.gloss: power distribution board; electrical panel; switchboard
definitions.explanation: A panel or board that distributes electrical power from a main source to various circuits within a building. Contains circuit breakers, switches, and fuses.

examples.japanese: {配電盤|はいでんばん}のブレーカーが{落|お}ちた。
examples.english: The breaker on the electrical panel tripped.

examples.japanese: {配電盤|はいでんばん}の{点検|てんけん}は{定期的|ていきてき}に{行|おこな}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: The distribution board needs to be inspected regularly.

examples.japanese: {停電|ていでん}のときはまず{配電盤|はいでんばん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: When there's a power outage, first check the electrical panel.

notes:
Compound of {配電|はいでん} (power distribution) + {盤|ばん} (board/panel). Found in every building, from homes to factories. Knowing this word is practical for everyday life in Japan, especially when dealing with electrical issues or reading building guides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配電盤|はいでんばん}の{点検|てんけん}: inspection of the electrical panel
- {配電盤|はいでんばん}の{交換|こうかん}: replacement of the distribution board
- {配電盤|はいでんばん}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the electrical panel
- {主|しゅ}{配電盤|はいでんばん}: main distribution board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分電盤|ぶんでんばん}: sub-distribution panel; breaker box — the household version that divides circuits for rooms
- ブレーカー: breaker; circuit breaker — individual safety switches within the panel
- {制御盤|せいぎょばん}: control panel — for controlling equipment, not just distributing power
- {電気|でんき}メーター: electric meter — measures usage, separate from the distribution board
